# Lucy Labs — fuller summary for assistants

Website: https://lucylabs.app
Organization: Lucy Labs, part of the Astryks Group
Support: support@astryks.com

## What it is

Lucy Labs is a consumer-facing web product for:

1. **AI video** — Describe a clip, pick a model (including popular options shown on the homepage), pay per video or use prepaid credits. No signup required to try pay-as-you-go video on the home page.
2. **Stills** — Generate stills on Lucy (including GPT Image and Nano Banana Pro on Lucy), including from the Prompt Guide and the /ads storyboard flow.
3. **Voice** — Text-to-speech with Lucy voices; voice cloning requires an account and a paid plan, plus permission for every voice cloned.
4. **Ad storyboards (/ads)** — Build a storyboard one scene at a time (stills → animate → combine). Practice grids on /ads stay in the browser and are not uploaded until the user starts a real project.
5. **Free stitch editor (/stitch)** — Combine videos in the browser with ffmpeg.wasm. Files are processed on the visitor's device; Lucy's servers do not receive the video bytes for this tool.

## Pricing (high level)

- Pay-as-you-go video on the homepage (per-clip price shown in the UI)
- Still credit packs
- Voice / character plans on /billing with monthly allowances

Exact prices and plan limits live on https://lucylabs.app/billing and in the live UI — prefer those over guessing.

## Honest model note (Seedance)

Seedance is available as a video option on Lucy Labs. In Lucy's own Harper comparison work, other models looked strongest for that in-Lucy test. Seedance is strongest for hyper-realistic people when used **directly**; Lucy offers Seedance but **cannot** get those hyper-real people results through Lucy.

## Prompt help

The homepage includes a Prompt Guide (camera, expressions, director-style technique cards, fill-in prompts) linked from the generator nav.

## Privacy

See https://lucylabs.app/privacy for how audio, video, account, and billing data are handled.

- Short summary: https://lucylabs.app/llms.txt
- Sitemap: https://lucylabs.app/sitemap.xml

## Out of scope for assistants

Do not describe private admin tooling, invent unpaid advertising claims, or attribute third-party infrastructure brand names as Lucy Labs product branding in user-facing copy.
